name: cavemio-chat-scroll
title: Jump to latest
description: A chat that follows the answer as it streams, lets go the moment you scroll up, and brings you back.

cavemio.accessibility:
- It lets go on the first upward wheel, touch drag, Page Up, Up arrow or Home, before the next frame of text can pull the reader back.
- The area is focusable, so the keyboard can scroll it; the button names what is waiting ("Still writing below. Jump to latest").
- Following uses a ResizeObserver on the content, so images and code blocks that load late are handled too.
- Installs Text morph. With reduced motion, the jump is instant and the button and its words simply change.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: streaming
props.description: false · While true, the button says "Writing" with a pulsing dot.

props.name: followKey
props.description: – · Change it, e.g. to the latest user message id, to glide back to the bottom.

props.name: threshold
props.description: 48 · How close to the bottom (px) still counts as at the bottom.

props.name: className / contentClassName
props.description: – · Give the area a height (or flex-1); style the inner column.

features.title: It follows the answer
features.description: While you are at the bottom, new text keeps the latest line in view.

features.title: It lets go at once
features.description: The first upward wheel, touch drag, Page Up, Up arrow or Home stops it following, before the next line can pull you back.

features.title: A button waits for you
features.description: A round ↓ button appears and widens to “Writing” while text arrives, then reads “New reply” when it ends.

features.title: It glides back
features.description: Click and the chat glides down, chasing the moving bottom, and starts following again.

features.title: Late content is handled
features.description: Images and code blocks that load after the text no longer push the reader off the bottom.

features.title: Keyboard friendly
features.description: The area is focusable so the keyboard can scroll it, and the button says what is waiting.

states.title: following
states.description: At the bottom: new content keeps the latest line in view, with no visible jumps.

states.title: away
states.description: You scrolled up: it stops following immediately and a round ↓ button fades up.

states.title: new below
states.description: Content arrived while you were away: the button widens (380ms) into a pulsing "Writing" while streaming; when it ends, "Writing" morphs into "New reply" and the pulse settles.

states.title: back
states.description: The button glides to the bottom, re-reading it each frame, and following resumes. Changing followKey does the same.
